statement.p: Use the ratio test to find the open interval of convergence of \sum_{n=1}^\infty\,{n^3\,x^{3 n}\over 5^{3 n}}.

p.em: (Enter your answer as an interval: thus, if the interval of convergence were -3 \lt x\lt 5, you would enter (-3,5). Use Inf for any endpoint at infinity.)

solution.p: We use the ratio test: \left|{a_{n+1} \over {a_n}}\right| = \left|{{(n+1)^3 x^{3(n+1)}} \over {5^{3(n+1)}}} \cdot {{5^{3 n}} \over {n^3 x^{3 n}}}\right| = \left({{n+1} \over n}\right)^2 \cdot {{x^3} \over 125}. Since {{(n+1)}/ n} \rightarrow 1 as n \rightarrow \infty, we have \lim_{n\to\infty} \left|{{a_{n+1}} \over {a_n}}\right|={{x^3}\over 125}. We have {{x^3}/ 125} \lt 1 when |x| \lt 5. The radius of convergence is 5 and the series converges for -5 \lt x \lt 5. (And we don't know what happens at x=2 or x=-2.)
